fit_reason: Whole 16-foot aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer, sold by a private owner (a relative of the late owner).
findings: Cockpit cluttered with loose gear: anchor, trolling motor prop, coiled rope, bucket, crates and long wooden boards laid across the seats
Gray carpet on the deck looks dusty and dirty, with debris scattered around
Seat cushions look dull and dusty, with a dingy tan cast
Painted hull sides along the port side look dull and chalky, with grime toward the lower hull
Black transom panel and side trim look faded and dull
Johnson outboard cowling looks dull and yellowed
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1991 Sylvan Back Troller. With the gear and boards cleared out, the deck carpet and seats cleaned, and the hull sides and motor cowling washed and polished, the boat would show a lot better in photos and to buyers. We do pre-sale details on boats and come to you. Would you like a quote?
